verdict.rationale: Decagon is a SaaS customer-support AI platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence shows none: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the llms.txt file is a site description, not an API specification. The marketing docs stress 'no custom code required' and never mention a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
